fullPassage:
Dear Dog Owners,
My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a wonderful time with your dogs in this newly opened park.
Regards,
Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to ①<u>provide</u> an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas ②<u>where</u> your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ③<u>ensuring</u> safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for ④<u>resting</u> and staying cool.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①제공하다 ②~하는(곳) ③보장하는(→ensure) ④쉬는
det.analysis:
❌ ③ ensuring → ensure: to부정사(to ensure) 구조에서 to 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 함
✅ ① provide: to부정사 뒤 동사원형 정상
❌ ② where: 장소 관계부사 정상
❌ ④ resting: 전치사 for 뒤 동명사 정상
det.tip: to + 동사원형: to ensure(○) / to ensuring(×)

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently ①<u>opened</u> a new dog park. The park was ②<u>designing</u> to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have ③<u>separate</u> spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure ④<u>safety</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①열었다 ②설계하는(→designed) ③별도의 ④안전
det.analysis:
❌ ② designing → designed: 수동태 was designed(설계되었다)이 올바름. The park이 주어이므로 수동태 필요
✅ ① opened: 과거시제 정상
❌ ③ separate: 형용사 정상
❌ ④ safety: 명사 정상
det.tip: 수동태: was + p.p. The park was designed(○) / was designing(×). 주어가 행위 대상일 때 수동태

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and ①<u>I'm</u> the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to ②<u>make</u> the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, ③<u>ensured</u> safety. You'll also find lots of ④<u>benches</u> and areas for resting and staying cool.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①나는 ~이다 ②만들다 ③보장된(→to ensure) ④벤치들
det.analysis:
❌ ③ ensured → to ensure: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사(to ensure safety = 안전을 보장하기 위해)가 필요. ensured(과거분사)로는 목적 표현 불가
✅ ① I'm: I am 축약 정상
❌ ② make: to부정사 뒤 동사원형 정상
❌ ④ benches: 복수명사 정상
det.tip: 목적의 to부정사: to ensure safety(안전을 보장하기 위해). 과거분사 ensured와 혼동 주의

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an ①<u>enjoyable</u> experience for both dogs and owners. There are big ②<u>grassy</u> areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ③<u>endanger</u> safety. You'll also find lots of ④<u>benches</u> and areas for resting and staying cool.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①즐거운 ②잔디가 깔린 ③위험에 빠뜨리다(→ensure 보장하다) ④벤치
det.analysis:
✅ ③ endanger(위험에 빠뜨리다)는 ensure(보장하다)의 반의어. 안전을 '위험에 빠뜨리기' 위해 공간을 분리했다는 것은 모순
❌ ①②④ 원문 일치
det.tip: endanger↔ensure/protect. 소형견/대형견 분리 목적은 안전 '보장'

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more ①<u>dog-friendly</u>, we recently opened a new dog park. The park was designed to provide an ②<u>unpleasant</u> experience for both dogs and owners. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can ③<u>run</u>, jump, and play. We have ④<u>separate</u> spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①반려견 친화적인 ②불쾌한(→enjoyable 즐거운) ③뛰다 ④별도의
det.analysis:
✅ ② unpleasant(불쾌한)은 enjoyable(즐거운)의 반의어. 반려견 친화적 공원에서 불쾌한 경험을 제공하겠다는 것은 모순
❌ ①③④ 원문 일치
det.tip: unpleasant↔enjoyable/pleasant. dog-friendly + enjoyable이 논리적 맥락

questions.passage: My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. We have __________ spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 안전을 보장하기 위해 소형견과 대형견을 위한 __________ 공간이 있습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① separate: 안전을 위해 크기별로 분리
❌ ② shared(공유된) — 안전 보장과 맞지 않음
❌ ③ hidden(숨겨진) — 맥락 무관
❌ ④ narrow(좁은) — 크기 분리와 관련 없음
det.tip: to ensure safety → separate spaces. 분리가 안전 보장의 수단

det.korean: 지역사회를 더 __________하게 만들기 위해 새 반려견 공원을 개장했습니다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② budget-friendly(저예산) — 비용 언급 없음
❌ ④ child-friendly(아이 친화적) — 반려견 대상
det.tip: dog-friendly = 반려견 친화적. 글 전체가 반려견을 위한 시설 소개

det.korean: 공원은 더 __________ 지역사회를 만들기 위한 계획의 일환으로 건설되었습니다.
det.analysis: ✅ dog-friendly: 원문 'make the community more dog-friendly'. built=opened, plan=goal 패러프레이징
det.tip: dog-friendly = 반려견 친화적. 패러프레이징: built→opened, plan→goal

questions.passage:
Dear Dog Owners,
My name is Lily Paxton, and I'm the town's Pet Program Coordinator. As part of our goal to make the community more dog-friendly, we recently opened a new dog park. ____. There are big grassy areas where your dogs can run, jump, and play. We have separate spaces for small dogs and big dogs, to ensure safety. You'll also find lots of benches and areas for resting and staying cool. We hope you will have a wonderful time with your dogs in this newly opened park.
Regards,
Lily Paxton, Pet Program Coordinator
questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)
[ was / the park / to provide / designed / an enjoyable experience / for both dogs and owners ]

det.korean: 공원은 반려견과 주인 모두에게 즐거운 경험을 제공하도록 설계되었습니다.
det.analysis: ✅ The park was designed to provide an enjoyable experience for both dogs and owners
det.tip: 수동태: S + was + p.p. + to부정사
